evidence.quote: ADB SAFEGATE has successfully delivered four Safedock T1 Advanced Visual Docking Guidance Systems (A-VDGS) and a SafeControl Apron Management (SAM) System
ADB SAFEGATE is the market leader in docking guidance systems with 45 of the 50 largest airports in the world using Safedock A-VDGS.
During construction of the new terminal, ADB SAFEGATE installed an additional 28 Safedock systems on the new international gates
ADB SAFEGATE has installed over 7,000 Safedock advanced visual docking guidance systems across the globe.
as well as its SafeControl Apron Management software at both terminals.
The launch of the updated Power HF at inter airport follows a successful field test at Brussels Airport.
The company’s latest solution, the Integrated Controller Working Position (CWP), will also be showcased at the event.
The airport has chosen AviBit, now a part of ADB Safegate, to install its Integrated Tower Solution to enable A-CDM
